facts.big: going to + verbo · have to + verbo
facts.label: Going to e have to
facts.sub: Use am/is/are going to + verbo para planos e have/has to + verbo para obrigações: We’re going to pack boxes. I have to be there at nine.

facts.label: Obrigação
facts.sub: Para falar de uma obrigação, use have to + verbo base: I have to be there at nine. Com he, she e it, use has to: Everyone has to wear one.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para falar de planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: We’re going to pack boxes. Para perguntar, use What are you going to do? ou How many people are going to help?

pages.title: A community hall · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday evening in a community hall in Auckland. Tables and boxes fill the room. Marco reads a list on the wall. His friend Rosa comes in with a bag. She sees the team shirts. She asks about Sunday.

“Hi, Marco! What are you going to do on Sunday?” says Rosa. “I’m going to volunteer at the food bank. I have to be there at nine.” says Marco. “That’s early! What are you going to do there?” says Rosa.
